title: Relative separated morphisms are detected after a dominant map
statement: Let $W,T,Y,S$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $T$ reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. Let $s:Y\to S$ be separated [def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $a,b:T\to Y$ be morphisms satisfying $s\circ a=s\circ b$. Let $h:W\to T$ be a morphism with dense image, meaning $\overline{h(|W|)}=|T|$. If $a\circ h=b\circ h$ as scheme morphisms, then $a=b$.
